steps: Identify the damaged panel and locate the seam above it.
Use a zip tool to unhook the panel above from the damaged one.
Remove nails from the damaged panel and slide it out.
Cut and fit a matching replacement panel, nailing loosely to allow expansion.
Re-hook the panel above back into place.
pro_questions: Can you source siding that matches my existing profile, color, and manufacturer?
Will you inspect and repair the weather barrier or house wrap behind the damaged section?
Is there moisture damage, rot, or mold in the wall cavity that needs to be remediated first?
Will the repair be visually seamless, or will there be a visible patch or color difference?
Is a permit required for siding replacement in my area?
What is the warranty on materials and your workmanship?
